# MDL013: mdl-exception

A malformed exception clause.

Wrong attribute set for the kind, `on` inside a body, missing `on` at top level, an unknown rule id, a malformed `ticket` or `until`, or a `grimble:accept` style directive in a .grmb comment.

## Examples

### MDL013 malformed exception / A top-level accept without on fires #1 (line 6) (fire)

```text
grimble = "2";
module m;
node cli : trusted {
}
accept SYS004 because="missing on";
```

### MDL013 malformed exception / An unknown rule id fires #2 (line 16) (fire)

```text
grimble = "2";
module m;
node cli : trusted {
  accept NOPE999 because="unknown rule id";
}
```

### MDL013 malformed exception / A well-formed accept is clean #3 (line 26) (clean)

```text
grimble = "2";
module m;
node cli : trusted {
  accept SYS004 because="one-way import by design";
}
accept SYS004 on cli because="also top-level";
```
